title: Withdrawal (Pull-Out) Method
aliases: pull out korle pregnancy hoy ki
summary: Withdrawal means pulling the penis out before ejaculation. It's better than nothing but one of the least reliable methods, partly because pre-cum can contain sperm, and it gives no STI protection.
